audit.why: 50.23% over 3094 games, marked EVEN at 5.5/10. That matches a lane Fizz wins on tempo and loses on scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers of the level chart disagree on four of seven rows: full phases[].side reads Skill/Fizz/Fizz/Skill/Fizz/Skill/Vladimir while content win[] reads Fizz on all seven. Rows 3, 5 and 6 also carry whys that describe Fizz winning a stage the side column gives away. whys[5] and whys[6] are additionally swapped — whys[5] sits on the First item row but discusses the 2-item mark, and whys[6] sits on 2+ items but discusses the first-item spike.
audit.why: Crimson Pact converts 30 bonus health into 1 AP and 1 AP into 1.6 health, so item health directly pads him against Fizz's string; Hemoplague heals him for each champion hit. An even 50.23% matchup cannot be a seven-row Fizz sweep. The full-layer sides are the coherent set, so the content layer is brought to them.
audit.corrected: win[0]=Skill, win[3]=Skill, win[5]=Skill, win[6]=Vladimir, with the matching whys and phases[].why rewritten to argue the same verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the decisive interaction: Sanguine Pool's 2 seconds of untargetability eats a committed Fizz string outright, and Transfusion costs no mana at all, so chip damage is refunded. breakdown.cooldowns carries no number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Kit: W Sanguine Pool 28/25/22/19/16s, 2s untargetable, slows and siphons; Q Transfusion 9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s at zero cost with heal; E Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so standing behind your own wave denies it; R Hemoplague 120s, heals per champion hit. Fizz E Playful/Trickster is 16/14/12/10/8s and untargetable, the mirror of his pool.

The packet levelChart reads seven Fizz rows, which disagrees with both the full layer's mixed sides and the 50.23% EVEN rating; I resolved to the full layer and brought the content win[] rows to it rather than the packet, because Crimson Pact's health-to-AP conversion gives a kit-grounded reason for the late rows to flip. Tides of Blood being blocked by enemy units (so his own or your wave eats it) is in Riot's text but is not asserted anywhere on the page — I did not have a length-neutral field to put it in without displacing a grounded line; flagging it here.
